## Acceptance Criteria
(Acceptance criteria is a list of specific requirements that the User Story must meet. These are unique for each User Story.)

- [ ] Acceptance Criteria 1
- [ ] Acceptance Criteria 2
- [ ] Acceptance Criteria 2

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are verified and met.
- [ ] Out-of-scope changes are split into separate tasks or documented.
- [ ] Code is readable, follows project style, and avoids unnecessary complexity.
- [ ] Code is backwards compatible (or deprecated code has no consumers).
- [ ] Pre-commit hooks pass (lint, format, tests).
- [ ] CI/CD pipeline is green.
- [ ] Unit tests use mocks.
- [ ] Existing tests pass for impacted components.
- [ ] Feature is manually tested by another team member (before and after deployment).
- [ ] Tested on target browsers.
- [ ] Documentation is up-to-date.
- [ ] Performance impact is acceptable for expected usage.
- [ ] At least one peer review is completed with major comments resolved.
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data committed.
